**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document contains no audit, inspection or verification right running against Sparkling. Section 3 imposes use restrictions (no copying, no reverse engineering, no service bureau use) but gives Garman no right to verify compliance; Section 14 addresses confidentiality only; Section 20 has no audit mechanic. The single examination right in the agreement — Section 16 escrow (p0114), allowing Sparkling or its independent experts to examine and test materials for Garman's compliance — runs in our favour.

Since no verification right binds the Customer, our position exceeds the preferred playbook position (annual, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor cost, no system access). Proposing audit language would only invite a right that does not currently exist, so no edit was made.
